name: CD34 molecule

function.text: CD34 encodes hematopoietic progenitor cell antigen CD34. Annotated molecular activities include RNA polymerase II-specific DNA-binding transcription factor binding and carbohydrate binding. It participates in signal transduction and hemopoiesis.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.
